execute:
  echo: true
  warning: false
  error: false

## Question

State the biological question and the prespecified primary contrast.

## Data and design

Describe the species, experimental unit, biological replicate counts, accession,
reference/annotation release, and any batch or covariate decisions.

## Methods

Describe filtering, raw-count model, normalization used for visualization,
primary differential-expression method, sensitivity analyses, and enrichment
universe. Link each claim to an evidence ID where appropriate.

## Results

Use figures and tables generated by the pipeline. Record the Git commit and
configuration hash in the run ledger.

## Limitations

Separate observations directly supported by the data from biological
interpretations and hypotheses for follow-up experiments.
